data.name: AddressHint
data.value: The phone finds the server by itself. If it doesn't, scan this QR code in the app settings or enter the address there.

data.name: OtherAddresses
data.value: All addresses of this PC (try the next one if the phone can't connect):

data.name: StatePortBusy
data.value: Port {0} is used by another program

data.name: FirewallWarning
data.value: Windows Firewall may block the phone.

data.name: FirewallQuestion
data.value:
Windows Firewall may block connections from the phone.
Allow Truck Remote Server in the firewall? Administrator rights are required.

data.name: FirewallNotApplied
data.value: The firewall rule wasn't applied. Allow Truck Remote Server (UDP port {0}) in your firewall manually.

data.name: PluginNotInstalled
data.value:
The telemetry plugin wasn't installed: {0}
The controls work without it, only the truck state isn't shown on the phone.

data.name: GameNotFound
data.value:
{0} wasn't found. If it isn't installed, press Cancel to skip it, otherwise press OK and select its folder.
For example: {1}

data.name: JoystickWarning
data.value: vJoy isn't installed or set up: the phone can't steer.

data.name: JoystickQuestion
data.value:
vJoy (a virtual joystick driver) isn't installed or set up, without it the phone can't steer.
Install and set it up now? Administrator rights are needed, Windows may also ask to trust the vJoy driver.

data.name: JoystickSetupFailed
data.value: vJoy wasn't set up. Install vJoySetup.exe from the release manually and enable the X axis of device 1 in Configure vJoy.

data.name: PortHint
data.value: The same port must be set in the app. Change it only if this one is used by another program.

data.name: TrayHint
data.value: The server keeps working here. Double-click the icon to open it.

data.name: QrCode
data.value: QR code of the server address

data.name: WizardSubtitle
data.value: Everything the phone needs to drive the truck. Fix what is marked, then connect the phone and try the controls.

data.name: WizardWorkingAdmin
data.value: Working… Allow the changes in the window of Windows.

data.name: WizardPluginDone
data.value: Installed: the phone shows the dashboard and vibrates with the truck.

data.name: WizardPluginMissing
data.value: Not installed: the phone drives the truck, but shows no dashboard and has no vibration of the road.

data.name: WizardJoystickDone
data.value: Ready: the phone steers through vJoy device 1.

data.name: WizardJoystickMissing
data.value: Not set up: without it the phone can't steer or press the pedals smoothly.

data.name: WizardJoystickFailed
data.value: The setup didn't help. Restart the PC and try again, or reinstall vJoy.

data.name: WizardFirewallDone
data.value: The packets of the phone are let in.

data.name: WizardFirewallBlocked
data.value: Blocks the phone: allow the server in the firewall.

data.name: WizardFirewallFailed
data.value: The rule didn't help: another firewall or an antivirus may block the server.

data.name: WizardControlsDone
data.value: Done by the server: profiles of ETS2 and ATS get vJoy and the keys of the cruise control. A running game gets them after it is closed.

data.name: WizardPhoneWaiting
data.value: Open Truck Remote on the phone: it finds the server by itself when the phone is on the same Wi-Fi as the PC. Or scan this code: Settings → Connection → Scan the QR code of the server.

data.name: WizardPhoneDone
data.value: Connected. Tilt the phone and press the pedals: the bars move as the game gets them.

data.name: WizardPhoneNoServer
data.value: The server isn't running: its port is busy. Choose another port in Settings.

data.name: UpToDate
data.value: You have the latest version of the server.
